description: This Python source file defines classes and methods for generating and validating CloudZero Resource Names (CZRN) specifically for LiteLLM resources, including normalization and extraction of CZRN components.

classes.name: CZEntityType
classes.description: An enumeration for entity types, currently only 'team'.

classes.name: CZRNGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating, validating, and extracting components from CloudZero Resource Names (CZRN) for LiteLLM resources.

methods.name: create_from_litellm_data
methods.description: Creates a CZRN string from a dictionary containing LiteLLM resource data, mapping specific fields to CZRN components.

methods.name: create_from_components
methods.description: Constructs a CZRN string from individual components, normalizing each as needed.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates whether a given CZRN string matches the expected format.

methods.name: extract_components
methods.description: Extracts and returns all components from a CZRN string as a tuple.

methods.name: _normalize_provider
methods.description: Normalizes provider names to standard CZRN format using a mapping.

methods.name: _normalize_component
methods.description: Normalizes individual CZRN components to meet format requirements, handling case and invalid characters.
